name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
November 10, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Sister Madeline Fitzgerald of St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring November 12, 2009, "Champion in the Community Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P2.
Presentation of Certificates of Appreciation to Outgoing Youth Commissioners and Oath of Office and presentation of Certificates of Appointment to Incoming Youth Commissioners. (CC)
P3.
Proclamations declaring a day in the honor of the following recipients of the Annual City of Vista Employee Service Recognition Awards: (CC)
A.
November 13, 2009, "Walter Hartman Day" - 2009 Employee of the Year
B.
November 14, 2009, "Chuck Crist Day" - 2009 Manager of the Year
C.
November 15, 2009, "Roger Brenzel Day" - Mayor's Excellence in Service
P4.
Presentation by Claudia Valenzuela, San Diego Gas & Electric Public Affairs
Manager, on the Smart Meter Program & Installation Information (CC)
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending September 30, 2009 (CC)
C4.
Set Annual Joint Powers Financing Authority Meeting Time (JPFA)
C5.
Special Event Banner Program for the 2009 Calendar Year (CC)
C6.
Cabaret License Application for John's Restaurant located at 1280 E. Vista Way, Suites 1-3 (CC)
C7.
Assignment of Citywide Street Sweeping Contract (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving Amendment No. 3 to the agreement with CleanStreet, Inc.; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving Amendment No. 4 to the agreement with EDCO Disposal Corporation.
C8.
Amendment to the Vista Development Code Standards for Public Works
Construction (CC)
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 16.04 of the Vista Development Code by Adopting the 2009 Edition of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction, and (recommended action continued on following page) (recommended action continued from previous page)
the 2009 Edition of the San Diego Area Regional Standard Drawings including Indices and Appendices by Reference with Additions and Amendments; and
2.
Set a Public Hearing for December 8, 2009, for adoption of the ordinance.
C9.
Environmental Enhancement and Mitigation Program Grant Application (CC)
C10.
Vista Home Ownership Program Budget Amendment & Program Modification (CDC)
1.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving an increase to the program budget in the amount of $360,000, and authorizing the Executive Director to execute all necessary documents to implement the program; and
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2009/10.
C11.
Loan Agreement with Teri, Inc. (CC/CDC)
1.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Loan Agreement between the Commission and TERI, Inc., and authorizing the Chair or his designee to execute the agreement and any other documents necessary to implement the project;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Loan Agreement between the Commission and TERI, Inc., making a finding of benefit, and authorizing the use of low and moderate income housing funds outside of the Vista Redevelopment Project area; and
3.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2009/2010.
C12.
Grounds and Landscape Maintenance Agreement (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Responsible Beverage Sales and Service Ordinance (CC)
D2.
Vista City Maintenance Association Impasse Proceedings (CC)
D3.
Fiscal Year 2008/09 Fourth Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the report; and
2.
Provide direction to staff as to the recommended use of year-end fund balance.
D4.
Vista Conservancy Trail through Sycamore Creek Property (CC/CDC)
1.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- ; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- .
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Land acquisition and building lease for 325 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
PH2.
Lease Purchase and BMW Site and Building Lease (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , and Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , adopting a Negative Declaration for the Hitchcock Automotive Dealership Project; (recommended action continued on following page)
(recommended action continued from previous page)
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Purchase and Sales Agreement for the property located at 1715 Hacienda Drive;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , and Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Summary Report and a Site and Building Lease Agreement with Hitchcock Commercial Properties, L.P.; and
4.
Authorize the City Manager/Executive Director to execute the escrow instructions, deeds, and other documents and actions required to close escrow and implement the project on behalf of the City /Community Development Commission.
PH3.
Five-Year Redevelopment and Housing Implementation Plan (CDC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
